1. [blocking][issue-impact] The shared verifier releases its session before [apply_bulk_update](crates/jit/src/commands/bulk_update.rs:255) records `confirmed_skips` in the following loop. A concurrent mutation can therefore change a clean candidate after verification—for example, remove an already-requested gate declaration or alter its target field—while the new code reports “No changes needed.” The former per-issue path would open its own fresh session and return the current error or apply the needed update. This violates REQ-03’s behavior-preserving per-issue result requirement; no regression test covers the post-verification race.
